podcast.body: This album marked a deeper dive into "Sophisticop" for Joe Jackson, again recorded in New York City. It was infused with an even greater influence from Latin pop and jazz, further refining the stylistic direction he had begun with "Night and Day." The album broke into the top 20 on the album chart and produced the lead single "You Can't Get What You Want (Till You Know What You Want)," which reached number 15. "Joe Jackson went deeper into Sophisticop on his next album Body and Soul, which was also recorded in New York City, and infused with even greater influence from Latin pop and jazz."
